description: Components: units of the design, nested, each defining Languages, using Languages in its scope, offering Interactions over them and holding Transformations between them, exporting what others may reach, and importing what it depends on. A Component's Exports are its API: an Export makes one of its own Languages, Interactions, Transformations or children, or something a child exports, reachable from outside; an Import is of one Component — to place it, and to import from it — and takes some of its Exports. From outside, a Component is what it exports: an interface. Its children, Transformations and Deployments are its own implementation, and other Components may implement it. Extends Functions.

axioms.about: No Component is nested in itself, eventually
axioms.formula: all c in Component. not c in c.^parent

axioms.about: A Component uses only Languages in its scope: its own and its parents', and those it imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, l in c.uses. l.component in c.*parent or l in c.imports.exports.*export.language

axioms.about: A Language extends only Languages in the scope of its Component
axioms.formula: all l in Language, x in l.extends. x.component in l.component.*parent or x in l.component.imports.exports.*export.language

axioms.about: A Transformation's inputs are all of one Language
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, p in t.parameters, q in t.parameters. p.type.language == q.type.language

axioms.about: A Transformation has an output
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation. some t.output

axioms.about: A Transformation's output is of a Language other than its inputs'
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, p in t.parameters, o in t.output. p.type.language != o.language

axioms.about: A Transformation's inputs are in the vocabulary of a Language its Component uses
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, p in t.parameters. some u in t.component.uses. p.type.language in u.*extends

axioms.about: A Transformation's output is in the vocabulary of a Language its Component uses
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, o in t.output. some u in t.component.uses. o.language in u.*extends

axioms.about: An Interaction is over a Language its Component uses
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction. i.language in i.component.uses

axioms.about: Parameter types are in the vocabulary of the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p.type.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: The output is in the vocabulary of the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, o in i.output. o.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: An Export of a child exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.component => no e.interaction and no e.transformation and no e.language and no e.export

axioms.about: An Export of an Interaction exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.interaction => no e.transformation and no e.language and no e.export

axioms.about: An Export of a Transformation exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.transformation => no e.language and no e.export

axioms.about: An Export of a Language exports nothing else
axioms.formula: all e in Export. some e.language => no e.export

axioms.about: A Component exports only its own children
axioms.formula: all e in Export, k in e.component. k in e.exporter.components

axioms.about: A Component exports only its own Interactions
axioms.formula: all e in Export, i in e.interaction. i.component == e.exporter

axioms.about: A Component exports only its own Transformations
axioms.formula: all e in Export, t in e.transformation. t.component == e.exporter

axioms.about: A Component exports only its own Languages
axioms.formula: all e in Export, l in e.language. l.component == e.exporter

axioms.about: A Component re-exports only what its children export
axioms.formula: all e in Export, x in e.export. x.exporter in e.exporter.components

axioms.about: An Import takes only Exports of the Component it is from
axioms.formula: all m in Import, e in m.exports. e.exporter == m.from

axioms.about: A nested Component imports only from its siblings, from what a Component it is nested in imports from, or from a Component that it, or one it is nested in, imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, p in c.parent, m in c.imports. m.from != c and (m.from in p.components or m.from in c.^parent.imports.from or m.from in c.*parent.imports.exports.*export.component)

axioms.about: An imported Interaction is over a Language the importer uses
axioms.formula: all c in Component, i in c.imports.exports.*export.interaction. some u in c.uses. i.language in u.*extends

axioms.about: No Component implements itself, eventually
axioms.formula: all c in Component. not c in c.^implements

axioms.about: A Component imports what it implements
axioms.formula: all c in Component, x in c.implements. x in c.imports.from or x in c.imports.exports.*export.component

axioms.about: A Component uses the Language of every Interaction that what it implements exports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, x in c.implements, i in x.exports.*export.interaction. i.language in c.uses
